aboutText: With 19 years of experience, Melbourne Concreting Solutions is Melbourne's premier exposed aggregate specialist. We focus exclusively on exposed aggregate, ensuring drainage, falls, and base prep are done correctly on every job. As the preferred concreter for leading project builders, we deliver quality for driveways and outdoor areas. Contact us for a free ballpark on your project.
servicesText: Melbourne Concreting Solutions has 19 years of experience in exposed aggregate concreting. We specialise in driveways, paths, and outdoor areas, with meticulous attention to drainage, falls, and base preparation. Our services are trusted by leading project builders across Melbourne for reliable and durable results.
